messages:
Evelyn: Heads up — nightly SAST/DAST run had a ~3x spike in flaky failures between 02:00-03:00 UTC. Many are transient parser errors. Need to correlate with RBAC changes + KMS rotation window. Anyone oncall?

Raj: oncall now. can you paste a sample failing job id?

Evelyn: job: scan-nightly/2026-03-19/8172
Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/scan-nightly/8172 — stack traces show `json.Unmarshal` errors and a bunch of 429s from artifact-store.

Maria: We had an ephemeral KMS rotation at 02:05 UTC — might have caused artifact fetch auth hiccups. Rotation changelog: https://infra.redwood.ai/kms/rotations/2026-03-19 (see entry at 02:04:53).

Toni: Do we have auditlog events for artifact access failures? If we can signal the scanner that these failures are infra-level (not code issues) we should avoid creating noisy vuln tickets.

ScanBot: [scan-bot] Summary for run 8172: 12 flaky parser errors, 3 timeouts. Report: https://scans.redwood.ai/reports/8172

Sam: I can add a quick heuristic to ignore parser errors when the artifact proxy returns 5xx/429 on fetch. Will open a PR to scan-heuristics repo.

Evelyn: Also saw reviewer reassigns during that window — reviewer-queue flipped multiple times. Audit log trace would help to know if human reassigns were due to automation.

Olivia: product-security here — if reviewer auto-claiming dropped, rollout alerts should have fired. Did alerting catch this?

Raj: Alerting didn't fire — we saw a flurry of `reviewer_assigned` events but they were system retries; our audit pipeline dropped ~10% of events between 02:04-02:09 due to backpressure on the event bus. Investigating root cause now.

Maria: Starting a one-off backfill to recover dropped events from the raw store. ETA ~30m.

Toni: For triage, can we set a temporary rule: mark findings from this run as `investigate-if-persistent` and pause auto-remediation? We don't want automated rollbacks or severity escalations from flakes.

Evelyn: +1. Also, please add a header in the scan report: `X-Scan-Run-Note: TRACE-ID=<trace>` so we can match scanner traces to auditlog entries.

Sam: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/scan-heuristics/pull/432 — adds artifact-fetch status check and a `scan_meta[root_cause]` tag when fetch error codes are present. Example heuristic snippet:
```
if fetch_status in [429,502,503]:
  mark_as_infra_flake()
else:
  normal_analysis()
```

Olivia: Security will prepare a short compliance/customer blurb in case any false positives were auto-triaged. Please avoid shipping auto-mitigations until we finish the backfill.

Raj: Infra note: KMS rotation was graceful overall but a minority of workers used cached sessions with old creds for ~90s, causing auth failures to artifact-store proxied requests. We'll add jitter to session cache invalidation next rotation.

Evelyn: Actions assigned: 1) Maria — backfill auditlog events; 2) Sam — merge PR and patch scanner to add fetch-status tagging; 3) Toni — update triage playbook to pause auto-remed for run 8172; 4) Olivia — draft customer note for potential false positives. I'll follow up in #incidents if this escalates.

Maria: Backfill started @ 02:40 UTC — progress 60% — will ping when done :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ScanBot: [scan-bot] Backfill completed successfully. Reprocessed 8172 entries and re-evaluated heuristics.

Toni: Re-run results: 2 remaining confirmed true positives, 10 infra-flakes. Moving infra-flake findings to `needs-infra` tag and pausing auto-reassign.

Olivia: Drafted customer blurb, sending DM to Evelyn for approval.

Evelyn: Thanks. We'll also add a permanent audit-signal to nightly runs to include `artifact-fetch-status` and `trace_id` in metadata so future triage can be automated.

Raj: Follow-up ticket created: INFRA-1229 (audit pipeline resiliency & backpressure mitigation) — assigning to eng-infra.

Evelyn: Closing thread unless anyone has more to add.
